verdict.rationale: Buzz documents a workflow engine: agents can run workflows, the CLI has `buzz workflows trigger` and `buzz workflows approve`, and VISION.md describes YAML-as-code automation with traces. Nothing in the evidence shows these workflows can run on a schedule or repeat; the only trigger shown is a manual CLI invocation. missing for 10: cron/scheduled or recurring workflow triggers, documentation of schedule syntax or recurring job management, any hands-on or independent corroboration of scheduled runs.
